description: Provenance for docs/contract.json. Every contract statement traces to the OpenAPI document listed here, at the pinned commit.

sources.infoTitle: VMware Cloud Foundation API Reference Guide

operationIds.summary: Get the list of all Network Pools
operationIds.usedFor: Reads existing pools so the create can be skipped or reconciled. Declares no parameters at this revision.
The single mutating call. Request body is the NetworkPool schema; 201 returns the created pool, 400 covers validation failures including a name already in use.

revisionDiscrimination.why: The same file exists at tag 9.1.0.0 with a different Network schema. The contract is pinned to 9.0.0.0, so the 9.1.0.0 shape is a defect, not an alternative.
differences: Network.required is [gateway, mask, mtu, subnet, type, vlanId] at 9.0.0.0 and only [mtu, type, vlanId] at 9.1.0.0.
Network gains freeIpCount, ipAddressAssignmentMode, ipAddressVersion and usedIpCount at 9.1.0.0; none of these exist at 9.0.0.0.
The document grows from 280 paths at 9.0.0.0 to 320 at 9.1.0.0.

notes: No documentation page, SDK, blog post or model recollection was used as a contract source.

The 9.0.0.0 document declares no components.securitySchemes. The bearer Authorization header the client sends is recorded in docs/contract.json as a deployment convention and is explicitly flagged specDerived=false.
Nothing in this task contacts a VMware endpoint. The tests run against a loopback double on 127.0.0.1.
